english.title: Keep petrol on domestic / relevant premises in non-compliance with regulation 13
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) kept **(..SPECIFY AMOUNT OF PETROL..) of petrol in domestic or relevant premises, namely **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..),

(A)_[otherwise than in accordance with paragraph 1 or 2 of Schedule 2 to the Petroleum (Consolidation) Regulations 2014]_
(B)_[otherwise than in accordance with a licence authorising the keeping of petrol granted by the petroleum enforcement authority under regulation 14 of the Petroleum (Consolidation) Regulations 2014]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 4 and 13 of the Petroleum (Consolidation) Regulations 2014 and section 33(1)(c) and schedule 3A to the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
kept petrol in domestic / relevant premises
otherwise than in accordance with paragraph 1 or 2 of Schedule 2 OR
without a valid licence OR
otherwise than in accordance with a licence authorising the keeping of petrol granted by the petroleum enforcement authority under regulation 14

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Either Way -

Summary: Maximum 12 months imprisonment / or a fine
Indictment: Maximum 2 years imprisonment and / or a fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

Notes:
In relation to an offence committed before section 154(1) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 comes into force, the reference to 12 months imprisonment in relation to summary offences, above, is to be read as a reference to 6 months imprisonment.
